C63.content_en:
Ways to take a screenshot of a site — and how the main tools compare

Site owners and marketers sometimes want to keep a record of how their own page, or a nearby rival's page, looks right now. Enter one URL and this tool shows a full-page screenshot.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.0048 per call (measured), roughly 200 per $1One full-page image. The image URL can be saved to CSV
ScreenshotOneThe free plan gives 100 screenshots a month; the Basic plan is $17 a month for 2,000 (official pricing page)A screenshot API service
Your device's built-in screenshot (by hand)FreeOnly what is on screen; a whole page takes several shots
Browser extensions (by hand)Many are free (check each extension)Some capture the whole page; there are many kinds

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • The whole page becomes one image. The sample, a shopify.com blog article, came out as one very tall image; the screen shows its top part (measured).
  • About $0.0048 per call. Roughly 200 per $1, so you can compare several rivals regularly.
  • About 20 to 35 seconds. We measured about 18 to 23 seconds on a Japanese page and about 34 seconds on the shopify.com article, so allow some time.
  • Keep the image URL. The CSV contains it.
  • Text renders as on the page. We checked the shopify.com article (English) and a Japanese page; the text appeared as it should.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want to keep the image for a long time → the image URL may expire (see the official site). Save important images yourself.
  • You want a mobile-width image → this tool returns a desktop-width image.
  • You want automatic daily records → this tool takes one shot when you press the button.
  • The image of a long page is large (about 6 MB for a Japanese page we tried in Japan), so mind your data use. Ads and parts that load later may not appear.

This tool does one thing: take one full-page screenshot of one page.

FAQ

Where is the image stored?

On DataForSEO's side. Right-click the image on screen and save it yourself.

What if the image does not show?

Try again after a while. The image URL is also in the CSV.

Isn't the image too long?

It covers the whole page, so it is tall. The screen shows the top part; save the image to see all of it.

Does the price change with page length?

We tried one page. The effect of length is untested.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

locale_en.c64.ai_prompt:
You are an assistant who helps organize web mentions.
The reader is a PR or sales person who wants to know how a company or product is written about online.

# About the data
- Date: {date}
- Country and language: {country} / {language}
- Rows: {n}
- Columns
  - Title / URL / date: the page with the mention.
  - Positive / negative / neutral: the sentiment numbers for that page.

# What I would like you to do
1. List pages with large negative numbers and sum up their title topics.
2. Count pages per domain.
3. List the 5 newest mentions.
4. The sentiment is automatic. Briefly say what cannot be known from the data alone (for example, the writers' real intent).

# Rules
- Use only the numbers I gave you. Do not make up numbers.
- Say "this is a guess" when you guess.
- Write short and simple, so that a middle-school student can understand.
- Finish with a table (domain / pages).

# Data (tab-separated)
```
{data}
```

C64.content_en:
Ways to find web mentions of your company or product — and how the main tools compare

PR staff and business owners want to know where on the web their company or product name is being talked about. Enter a keyword and this tool lists up to 100 Japanese-language pages with title, URL, date and the positive/negative share.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.0276 per 100 rows (measured), roughly 36 calls per $1Up to 100 Japanese pages: title, URL, date and sentiment shares in a table. Save as CSV
Google AlertsFreeEmails you when new pages appear. It does not catch every mention (per Ahrefs' guide)
Google keyword search (by hand)FreeYou see today's results; counting is manual
Paid web-mention monitoring servicesVaries (see each official site)Services that watch news, social media and more; scope and features differ by vendor

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Narrowed to Japanese. Only pages DataForSEO labels as Japanese-language pages are listed.
  • Sentiment shares per page. Positive, negative and neutral shares line up row by row.
  • Open pages quickly. The URL is a link to the page itself.
  • About $0.0276 per call. That is 100 rows, roughly 36 calls per $1.
  • Save as CSV. Groundwork for a PR report.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want social media posts → this table covers web pages; social posts are not necessarily included (see the official site).
  • You need dates → only 10 of the 100 rows we got had a date (measured). Rows without one are blank.
  • You want only the company's own pages → shopping sites and roundup sites that mention the word appear too. Also, even for pages labelled Japanese, some rows had English body text (measured: 39 of 100).
  • You want automatic daily alerts → this tool shows the result when you press the button. Google Alerts fits better.

This tool does one thing: show up to 100 Japanese pages containing a keyword, with title, URL, date and sentiment shares.

FAQ

Which languages are covered?

Only pages DataForSEO labels as Japanese-language. The filter is fixed by this tool. The body text can be judged differently.

What are the sentiment shares?

DataForSEO analyses each page's text and gives positive, negative and neutral shares. A person did not judge them.

Can I see more than 100?

This tool stops at 100. For the total count, use the tool "See a summary of mentions".

Why do unrelated shop pages appear?

Every page containing the keyword is included, including shopping pages that use the same word as a company name.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
